name: marketing-agent
description: Jordi Driesen's marketing plugin: a team of subagents plus the skill library they run on, in one install.

plugins.name: marketing-agent
plugins.description: A marketing team for Claude: a director plus thirteen specialist subagents (competitive intel, SEO/GEO, campaign strategy, content, social, email, graphic design, web development, paid ads, outbound SDR, sales enablement, localisation, reporting) and the skill library they run on. Client brand kits stay private and load via the [brand]-brand-kit naming pattern. Web development calls WordPress skills from the separate wordpress-development plugin.
